tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and coupled-lag signatures jointly favor the siphon-memory ODE. Acquire the trajectory batch to constrain memory decay and coupling before testing the model against the 0.045 fresh-confirmation RMSE tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon endpoints for five parameters leave no residual degrees of freedom. The narrow horizon range also makes memory decay and coupling strength difficult to separate.
It captures the spatial sink signature but omits the observed coupled transient lag.
It is cheaper but does not add the trajectory information needed to resolve the transient parameters.
